root_cause.text: Interrupts are enabled (via request_irq without IRQF_NO_AUTOEN) before the NAPI context is registered (via netif_napi_add_locked), allowing an interrupt to fire and invoke NAPI polling on an uninitialized NAPI structure.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "interrupts are automatically enabled immediately upon request. This allows interrupt to fire before the associated NAPI context is fully initialized". The patch adds the `IRQF_NO_AUTOEN` flag to `request_irq` and moves explicit `enable_irq` into `gve_add_napi` after `netif_napi_add_locked`, and adds `disable_irq` before `netif_napi_del_locked` in `gve_remove_napi`. The crash trace shows `__napi_poll` occurring during interrupt handling before NAPI is ready.
